workloads.label: Storage & egress · 100 GiB storage, 50 GiB egress
caveats: Metered compute is NOT priced here. This figure covers only a plan's fixed fee, storage, and egress — it is not the cost of running a database.

That omission cuts one way: a provider that folds compute into a fixed plan fee (Supabase, PlanetScale) has that compute counted, while a provider that meters compute separately (Neon, billed per CU-hour) has none of it counted and looks cheaper than it would on a like-for-like basis.

Egress is optional: where a provider has no recorded egress_gib row, this figure excludes egress entirely. It does not mean egress is free — it means either the provider bundles it at no separate charge (recorded as a $0 rate with a source) or no per-GB rate has been published. Do not read a figure with no egress row as proof egress is included.
Excludes support plans, committed-use discounts, and negotiated enterprise pricing.
Excludes backups beyond default retention and cross-region transfer.
